reason: Fixes a gap in note-merge's fold: when both notes being merged held an open proactive reminder, the merge left both rows alone and both went on to fire, because uq_reminders_proactive_open_note (PR #517) keys on the raw note id a row carries, and neither row's own note id ever collided. SqlNoteStore.merge_into now re-points or cancels the loser inside the fold's own transaction. Only reachable under [notes] merge_mode = "on", which production does not run (it runs "shadow"), so nobody sees a behaviour change from this yet -- it is a prerequisite for ever flipping that setting.
